id: title:gesh:stop guessing why a failure has no error message

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an informational icon and tooltip to the 'Not captured' status display and includes a regression test, potentially improving user understanding of missing event capture errors.
review.reason: The change is a localized, bounded UI and test update. P1.F1.H1 adds an icon dependency, P1.F1.H2 replaces plain text with a tooltip and icon for the 'Not captured' status, and P1.F2.H1 adds a regression test. This does not demonstrate a broader systemic capability or critical reliability improvement, fitting the criteria for a score of 1.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the tooltip and icon improve user comprehension, which cannot be verified without user testing or release notes. The score is assigned based on the implementation and test presence, not the unverified outcome.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned; score requires a judgment on the change's PostHog impact, not just its presence.

observations.behavior: Adds IconInfo to the imports, no other import changes.

observations.posthog_connection: Changes the UI of the "Not captured" status to include a tooltip and an icon, potentially improving user understanding of why an error message is missing.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case checking that the error context string does not contain "predates" and does contain "no $mcp_error_message on this event".
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test for the updated error message, ensuring the new behavior is preserved.
